name: Artemis Esports
shortDescription: An iRacing endurance, GT and NASCAR oval team.
heroLead: An iRacing endurance, GT and NASCAR oval team. We run the long races, the short tracks, and we bring the car home.
mission: Artemis fields an iRacing endurance crew, develops drivers who do not have a team yet, and publishes what we achieve.
focus: Endurance and GT racing on iRacing

pillars.title: Publish the result
pillars.line: Every race we enter as a team goes public within 48 hours, win or loss.
pillars.test: Test: can a stranger find our last five results without asking?

pillars.title: Debrief in the open
pillars.line: Every race gets a short written debrief and the Garage 61 data is shared.
pillars.test: Test: does the crew have a doc of what it is fixing before the next round?

pillars.title: The driver is the point
pillars.line: Time and money go to seat time and coaching before merch and graphics.
pillars.test: Test: name the last thing we did for a driver that nobody saw.

join.lead: We take drivers who show up prepared and stay calm in traffic. Pace matters. So does the hour before the race.

steps.title: Open a ticket
steps.line: Join the Discord and open a driver application in #recruitment.

steps.title: Share your numbers
steps.line: Your iRacing name, iRating, safety rating and the classes you run.

steps.title: Get in a car
steps.line: Run a practice session with the crew. Most drivers are placed within two weeks.

expectations.title: Practice
expectations.line: One team practice a week, plus your own laps before a round.

expectations.title: Commitment
expectations.line: One endurance entry a month for road, or the weekly league night for oval.

expectations.title: Conduct
expectations.line: Clean racing, a working microphone, and the debrief answered honestly.

expectations.title: Minimum age
expectations.line: 16, because that is the floor for the leagues we enter.
